name: Kvikkjokk-Tsielekjåkkstugan
description: Kvikkjokk to Tsielekjåkkstugan. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Route geometry starts after the Kvikkjokk/Sakkat boat transfer. The official section distance includes boat-plus-walk planning context, so check current Kvikkjokk boat operations before relying on it.
STF route says Tsielekjåkkstugan (not STF) while Naturkartan says the rest cabin is run by STF.
Official 15 km likely combines about 3 km boat and about 12 km walking. Naturkartan/official walking GPX starts after boat and does not include Kvikkjokk/Sakkat boat.
WFS and Naturkartan provide longer BD77/Kvikkjokk-Piteälven geometry that is not split at section 13. OSM/Waymarked is the only ready-made exact section relation and includes ferry.
Båttrafik has clearer 2026 season and times; Kvikkjokk-Turism/Boka sources still include 2025 booking/pricing language; STF boat page updated 2025-05-07.
Bus 94 PDF starts 2026-06-15 while regular boat timetable starts 2026-06-18.
Mallenjarka is a shelter/landing, but Naturkartan says overnight only in emergency and no stove.

facilities.name: STF Kvikkjokk Mountain Station
facilities.description: Trailhead service cluster with lodging, guest kitchen, cafe/restaurant, shop/resupply, sauna, Wi-Fi and nearby parking. STF notes 2026 renovation limitations and shop/food details.
facilities.routeProximity: start cluster; OSM relation includes station/start area

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk boat dock / Båttrafik Kvikkjokk
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 1437209072; operator page confirms service
facilities.description: Commercial passenger boat terminal for Kungsleden/Padjelanta access. Regular 2026 tours June 18-September 13; no rowboats.
facilities.routeProximity: required access connector from station to Sakkat boat

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk Kyrkan bus stop
facilities.description: Bus stop for access to Kvikkjokk by church, about 150-250 m from station depending source/path. Route 94 peak season, route 47 off-season context.

facilities.name: Kvikkjokk road-end parking
facilities.description: Parking at/near road end. Naturkartan says car park at trail start; station FAQ says parking near station.

facilities.name: Mallenjarka / Mallenjargga landing
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 1750214247; Naturkartan trail start nearby 66.9259373,17.7190185
facilities.description: Landing after the 3 km Sakkat boat transfer from Kvikkjokk. No rowboats. OSM notes a phone in the shelter for ferry pickup.

facilities.name: Raststuga Mallenjarka
facilities.description: Stopover cabin for temporary rests with room for 10, latrine, seasonal boat route, no stove, overnight only in emergency and no trash service.

facilities.name: Tsielekjåkkstugan / Tsielekjåhkå hut
facilities.coordinateSource: Naturkartan map/API; OSM node 1750214495 nearly same
facilities.description: Unstaffed, open year-round, no prebooking, stove/fireplace, outdoor toilet/latrine, emergency phone and limited beds. OSM tags drinking_water=yes and capacity 4.
facilities.routeProximity: section endpoint; route line is about 39-42 m away

facilities.name: Tsielekjåhkå bridge
facilities.description: Bridge/path crossing at Tsielekjåhkå immediately before/near hut; secondary reports call it a suspension bridge.
facilities.routeProximity: on route, about 50 m from hut

source.provider: Naturvårdsverket/Länsstyrelsen WFS BD77 hiking line plus separate Sakkat boat line
